versions.changelog: Normalize Morpho funding-mode/docs, accept bare private keys, re-thread live chained deployment from adapter receipts, remove scanner-triggering private-key examples, and publish a trimmed skill bundle without stale run artifacts.
Compact Morpho wrapper payload artifacts: compact default output, payloadRef/dataBytes/payloadOmitted deploy artifacts, dedicated transaction-payload files, and updated handoff/verification docs.

Harden the Morpho live wrapper path with preflight/decision artifacts, placeholder guards, deployment packs, live feed-funding and market verification handoff checks, plus the Arbitrum FRAX/USDC live canary fix for chained deployment artifacts.

Script more of the honest Morpho path, sync the packaged feed-funding runtime to the latest communal-proxy-aware flow, add rollback-plan.json artifacts for resumable runs, and fix packaged bin executability for real installs.
Move deployment bytecode out of inline literals and avoid false-positive secret-literal moderation hits
Replace secret-looking private key placeholders in CLI help text
Clarify this is the execution-capable Morpho variant and make the planning-to-live-deployment boundary more explicit.
Add explicit public metadata and strengthen the Morpho skill’s guarded execution contract, reporting boundaries, and verification language.
Rollback to the 0.1.0 public skill artifact while we investigate newer scanner regressions.
Reduce scanner-trigger language in the published Morpho bundle without changing the workflow contract.
Initial public Morpho skill release with validated packaging.
